title: Indian Railways Operates 19 Rail Neer Plants Across the Country, Supplying Safe Packaged Drinking Water to Passengers
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Railways

Indian Railways Operates 19 Rail Neer Plants Across the Country, Supplying Safe Packaged Drinking Water to Passengers

Capacity of Each Rail Neer Plant is 1 Lakh Bottles Per Day

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
05 AUG 2026 3:28PM by PIB Delhi

At present, the demand of Packaged Drinking Water (PDW) ‘Rail Neer’ in all the important trains and at stations is being met from the existing operational  Rail Neer plants across the country. Indian Railways Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) has been vested with the task of setting up Rail Neer plants at identified locations depending upon requirement and demand of Rail Neer over Indian Railways.

The tentative cost of setting-up of a Rail Neer Plant (PPP Model)  is about ₹10 crore for plant capacity of 1,00,000 bottles per day. The costs include construction of Pre-engineered Building (PEB) Shed, installation of Plant & Machinery and excluding the cost of land.
